name: read-implementation-types-layer
description: A layer-granularity `read` of `implementation_types`, the layer that was `data_types` until contract `8.0.0` and is stored in `data_types/implementation/` since. It answers the base's twelve value types and the value type `SyntheticTorque` — the stored view of the name `application_types` declares too — and no base type and no application type, each of which is an element of a layer of its own.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model plus one name declared in two layers: the application type `SyntheticTorque` (`data_types/application/`) and the implementation type `SyntheticTorque` (`data_types/implementation/`), a value type over the base's `float32_base`, each stating its bounds inline, and the mapping set `SyntheticTorqueMapping` (`data_types/mapping_sets/`) that pairs them. The base's twelve base types (`data_types/base/`) and twelve value types are unchanged.
context.notes: No `form` is stated, so the layer answers `summary`. `read-data-types-layer` reads the same layer at `full` over a fixture narrowed to two elements; this one reads the base's whole layer beside the pair.

expected.notes: A value type's `base` names an element of `base_types`, resolved in that layer alone, so the twelve `{name}_base` names here are references across layers and not members of this one.
